notes: Queue zip: B = tail ++ (0); map each x to the 4-atom quotation (x mul quote cat); fold with body [ [ uncons ] dip i ] pops the next neighbour off B's front and appends x*y to its back, leaving the adjacent products; then filter negatives and count. The i-run item quotations are 4 atoms, so within cap even though the measure only sees top-level bodies.
